name: Wasp_Stochastic Aggregation
brief: Wasp_Stochastic Aggregation | Inputs: PART, PREV, N, RULES, SEED, CAT, MODE, GC, ID, RESET → AGGR, PART_OUT
context: Wasp plugin component: core aggregation engine. Randomly selects parts and rules at each step to grow a discrete assembly. Works ADDITIVELY — increases to N grow the assembly, RESET clears it. PART_OUT feeds into Wasp_Get Part Geometry for visualization.
solution_principle: The stochastic aggregation engine randomly selects one part and one rule at each step. It is STATEFUL and ADDITIVE — parts accumulate over previous state. Increasing N grows incrementally, does not regenerate. RESET (Button) is the only way to clear state and restart. Requires WaspPart definitions (PART) and merged WaspRule list (RULES). Optional: SEED for reproducibility, CAT for part probability weights, GC for global constraints (bounding geometry), MODE for growth behavior. PART_OUT must be wired to Wasp_Get Part Geometry for visualization.
anti_patterns: Expecting re-solve to regenerate — it accumulates, use RESET
Forgetting RESET button — no way to clear accumulated state
Wiring AGGR instead of PART_OUT to geometry extraction
preconditions: Merged WaspRule list from Wasp_Rule + Merge
